inp = [[6,8,8,5],[8,8,1,8],[5,2,8,8],[1,5,1,8]]
expected = [[6,8,8,5,1,5,8,6],[8,8,1,8,5,2,8,8],[5,2,8,8,1,8,1,8],[1,5,1,8,8,8,8,5],[5,8,8,8,8,1,5,1],[8,1,8,1,8,8,2,5],[8,8,2,5,8,1,8,8],[6,8,5,1,5,8,8,6]]
def rotCCW(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m)][::-1]
def rotCW(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m[::-1])]
def rot180(m): return [r[::-1] for r in m[::-1]]
n=len(inp)
out=[[0]*(2*n) for _ in range(2*n)]
tl=inp; bl=rotCCW(inp); br=rot180(inp); tr=rotCW(inp)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        out[i][j]=tl[i][j]; out[i][j+n]=tr[i][j]
        out[i+n][j]=bl[i][j]; out[i+n][j+n]=br[i][j]
print(out==expected)
